Task: Magnesium NPT Equilibration for melting
Description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible nvt equilibrated Magnesium structure file and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, relax the system under NPT conditions with the given simulation parameters. Return the absolute path of the equilibrated structure file and the final density in gm/cm^3.

Required submission format:
{"density": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"density": "56.00", "path to relaxed structure": "/structures/structure.dat"}
